name: Contacts
tagline: The customer list every other module writes to

roadmap.note: Shipped and included with every workspace. Modules that own their own separate customer list can never be joined up later.

marketing.summary: A light customer list - name, contact details, a status, a note, and the history of everything that person has done with you. It is not a CRM you have to feed by hand: your other modules fill it in as customers arrive.
marketing.audience: Every workspace. Included at no extra cost on every plan, because the modules above it are far less useful without it.

features.title: Filled in for you
features.body: A captured lead, a booking, an accepted quote - each creates or updates a contact automatically. You are not doing data entry.

features.title: One history per person
features.body: Every conversation, request, appointment and quote for that customer sits on one screen, in order.

features.title: A status you choose
features.body: New, quoted, booked, won, lost, or whatever your work actually looks like. Simple enough to keep accurate.

features.title: Yours to take
features.body: Export the whole list as CSV whenever you want. A customer list you cannot get out is not really yours.

faq.q: Is this a replacement for HubSpot or Pipedrive?
faq.a: No. If you need pipelines, forecasting and sequences, use a real CRM. This exists so the other modules have somewhere sensible to put a customer, and so you can see one person's whole history.
No. It is part of the platform, on every plan including Free.
